mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ddc_i18n_published_override WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND catalog_scope_id=#{catalogScopeId} AND page_id=#{pageId} AND publish_operation_id=#{operationId} AND deleted_at IS NULL

WITH selected AS ( SELECT m.page_code, m.message_key, m.source_hash FROM ddc_i18n_source_message m JOIN ddc_catalog_activation_producer a ON a.tenant_id=m.tenant_id AND a.catalog_scope_id=m.catalog_scope_id AND a.source_id=m.source_id WHERE m.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND m.catalog_scope_id=#{catalogScopeId} AND a.activation_projection_id=#{projectionId} AND m.deleted_at IS NULL AND a.deleted_at IS NULL AND (m.page_code=#{pageCode} OR m.page_code='common') ORDER BY m.page_code, m.message_key LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset} ), winners AS ( SELECT m.page_code, m.message_key, h.reviewed_source_hashes_json::jsonb ->> m.message_key AS source_hash, h.publication_revision, h.translations_json, 'CURRENT' AS selection_kind FROM selected m JOIN ddc_i18n_published_override h ON h.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND h.catalog_scope_id=#{catalogScopeId} AND h.page_code=m.page_code AND h.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN ddc_i18n_page head ON head.tenant_id=h.tenant_id AND head.catalog_scope_id=h.catalog_scope_id AND head.id=h.page_id AND head.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE h.publication_revision=( SELECT MAX(previous.publication_revision) FROM ddc_i18n_published_override previous WHERE previous.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND previous.catalog_scope_id=#{catalogScopeId} AND previous.page_id=head.id AND previous.deleted_at IS NULL AND previous.publication_revision <= head.published_version AND jsonb_exists(previous.reviewed_source_hashes_json::jsonb, m.message_key) ) UNION ALL SELECT m.page_code, m.message_key, h.reviewed_source_hashes_json::jsonb ->> m.message_key AS source_hash, h.publication_revision, h.translations_json, 'MATCHING' AS selection_kind FROM selected m JOIN ddc_i18n_published_override h ON h.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND h.catalog_scope_id=#{catalogScopeId} AND h.page_code=m.page_code AND h.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN ddc_i18n_page head ON head.tenant_id=h.tenant_id AND head.catalog_scope_id=h.catalog_scope_id AND head.id=h.page_id AND head.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE h.publication_revision=( SELECT MAX(previous.publication_revision) FROM ddc_i18n_published_override previous WHERE previous.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND previous.catalog_scope_id=#{catalogScopeId} AND previous.page_id=head.id AND previous.deleted_at IS NULL AND previous.publication_revision <= head.published_version AND previous.reviewed_source_hashes_json::jsonb ->> m.message_key=m.source_hash ) ) SELECT p.page_code, p.message_key, p.source_hash, p.publication_revision, p.selection_kind, COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_object_agg(language.locale, language.translation) FROM ( SELECT jsonb_path_query(p.translations_json::jsonb, '$.keyvalue() ? (exists(@.value.keyvalue() ? (@.key == $messageKey))).key', jsonb_build_object('messageKey', p.message_key)) #>> '{}' AS locale, jsonb_path_query(p.translations_json::jsonb, '$.keyvalue().value.keyvalue() ? (@.key == $messageKey).value', jsonb_build_object('messageKey', p.message_key)) AS translation FROM selected one_key WHERE one_key.page_code=p.page_code AND one_key.message_key=p.message_key ) language), '{}'::jsonb)::text AS translations_json FROM winners p ORDER BY p.page_code, p.message_key, p.selection_kind
